facts.text: Sample Cache Depot was deployed at Jezero Crater during Perseverance (Mars 2020) in 2023.

Perseverance has collected and sealed rock core samples in titanium tubes, then deposited backup copies at the Three Forks cache depot in Jezero Crater. Ten tubes rest on the surface in a carefully mapped pattern. A future Mars Sample Return mission aims to bring these tubes to Earth — they would be the first samples returned from another planet.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Contains sealed rock cores that may hold biosignatures from an ancient lake — they would be the first samples ever returned from another planet.
Ten titanium tubes rest on the surface at Three Forks, awaiting a future Mars Sample Return mission to bring them to Earth.
